keys.what: the deploy smoke test's DEMO KEY (smokeTest.agentKey): deriveKeyPair() over a random stand-in, the address formula, published before the protocol required the agent formula (docs/SPEC.md §2). The reference agent does not hold it

the reference agent's own key: deriveAgentKeyPair() (the agent formula) over a WebAuthn-style PRF of a 32-byte seed held by the agent's host and the operator, outside this repository (examples/agent-memory/src/agent-key.ts). Published by the agent's owner with examples/agent-memory/scripts/publish-agent-key.ts; keyOfAgent(10260) returned it at epoch 2 after the transaction

smokeTest.label: DEMO KEY: SDK deriveKeyPair() over 32 random bytes standing in for a passkey PRF output; no passkey was used. The stand-in is kept outside the repository by the deployer's operator (so the drop can be opened again), and it opens anything sealed to this key: do not seal real notes to it

agentKey.label: DEMO KEY, derived the same way as the address key; its stand-in is kept outside the repository by the deployer's operator too: do not seal real notes to agent:10260 at epoch 1
